core_meaning.primary_meaning: Abdoulaye is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Servant of God”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Abdoulaye corresponds to the Arabic form عَبْدُ اللَّه (Arabic عبد (ʿAbd) + اللَّه (Allāh)). Its core sense is abdoulaye; servant of god (west african form). Abdoulaye is the West African (Fulani/Wolof) form of Arabic عَبْدُ اللَّه (ʿAbd Allāh), meaning 'servant of God'.

persian.name: عبدالله
